newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close narrowly mixed.

text.p: Rubber futures closed narrowly mixed in moderate trade on some late local buying and selling interest, brokers said on Wednesday.
The closure of the Japanese markets for the Adults Day holiday dampened sentiment, they said.

"The market was dead in the morning due to a lack of fresh incentives. Prices turned a little bit mixed in the afternoon on some late local buying and selling interest, but activity was limited by the absence of players due to the market holiday in Japan," a local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, February RSS3 eased 0.25 cent to 121.75 U.S. cents a kg.
March RSS1 was indicated at 176.75 Singapore cents (US$1.26) a kg compared with Tuesday's settlement of 176.25 cents.
March TSR20 slipped half a cent to 169.75 Singapore cents (US$1.21) a kg.
